supportedClaims: Two distinct local executions of the same bounded density-matrix request agree on purity, selected partial-transpose spectrum and negativity
outOfScope: Independent state tomography, experimental uncertainty, quantum channels or physical-hardware reproducibility
Entanglement claims beyond the selected bipartition and supplied density matrix

checks.criterion: The two Result Packages have distinct package digests and Session event traces.
Both executions use byte-identical canonical request digests, subsystem dimensions and selected transpose subsystems.
The independently validated purity values agree within the declared absolute tolerance.
The sorted selected partial-transpose spectra agree element-wise within the declared absolute tolerance.
The independently validated negativity values agree within the declared absolute tolerance.
